Why are there two bosses?!|audio = VoidcoreWave35-2.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 35 ([[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Void Keeper''', internally referred to as '''Void Grave Digger''', is a mini-boss that appears in both the [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes. It has a high amount of health and a decent fast speed, especially when combined with two of its abilities which either permanently or temporarily boost its speed. The '''Void Keeper''' has four abilities: #The first ability, ''Shovel'', has the '''Void Keeper''' digging up rocks from the ground, then flinging them at towers or units in a range of 20. Any tower hit by these rocks will get stunned for 4 seconds while units receive 150 damage. #The second ability, ''Summon'', makes the '''Void Keeper''' point its shovel into the air, temporarily giving it [[No Target]]. This makes purple lightning hit it, causing various enemies to start spawning for 4 seconds. These can be the [[Voidling]] (6% chance, 0.55 delay), [[Elite Lead]] (32% chance, 0.125 delay) or [[Mandrake]] (62% chance, 0.125 delay). Afterwards it receives around a 25% speed boost for 16 seconds. #The third ability is ''Stomp''. When performed, the '''Void Keeper''' will stomp the ground, creating a shockwave that stuns towers for 3 seconds and deals 150 damage to units. #The last ability is a rage mode type ability, the ''Wayfarer'', triggered when it reaches 25% of its health. Once reached, it will boost its speed to 3.5. ==Logbook Description== "''The Void Keeper is a specialized variant of Slow King who wallowed in the depths of their agony and decided they had to take on the task of burying their kingdom. After a realm collapse, the Void Keeper will quietly carry the dead and bury them. Some of the corpses will turn into food for the flora while others will either reanimate into Odds or decompose into skeletons. It is not known how the Void Keeper feels about this, but to this day it still quietly shovels away grave after grave.''" ==Appearance== The '''Void Keeper''' has a black body and purple eyes. It wears a purple coat with a hood, purple pants, black shoes, brown belts and multiple brown bandages. Its body is overgrown in various plants and flowers. On its left shoulder, it has a skull shoulder-pad while on its right, it has a regular purple shoulder-pad. It has a cracked purple tombstone attached to its right arm. On its back, it has a giant tombstone which is attached to its with a set of chains. It carries a shovel with its right arm. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers such as the [[Crook Boss]], [[Juggernaut]] and [[Turret]] are required to deal with the '''Void Keeper'''. **The [[Engineer]] is recommended against the [[Void Keeper]], with its sentries bypassing the '''Void Keeper's''' stuns and handling the large hordes that both spawn from and alongside it. **In [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode, the '''Void Keeper''' is spawned alongside the [[Void Brute]] and a large group of enemies. Bringing splash damage towers like the [[Mortar]] and [[Rocketeer]] is recommended. *During the '''Void Keeper's''' ''Summon'' ability, it gains the [[No Target]] attribute, preventing it from being attacked normally. As such, towers will be forced to to target its summons. *The [[Medic]] can be used to negate the '''Void Keeper's''' stuns, allowing for the '''Void Keeper''' to be killed before other enemies arrive to support it. Alternatively, stun immune towers like the [[Pursuit]] can be used instead. *Once the '''Void Keeper''' activates its ''Wayfarer'' ability, it becomes significantly faster. As such, bringing high range towers like the [[Ranger]] and [[Turret]] can prevent it from exiting the range of your towers. *The '''Void Keeper''' has no direct immunities other than those that come with the [[Boss]] attribute, so most freeze towers can help slow it down. Due to its size and the [[Boss]] attribute, stuns will only slow it down. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Hardcore Rework Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Void Keeper''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} HardcoreReworkPI2.png|'''Void Keeper''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} VoidKeeperCA.png|'''Void Keeper''' on its concept art. {{GalleryHeader|Badges}} DefeatVoidKeeperBadge.png|'''Void Keeper''' on its badge. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} VoidKeeperIconIG.png|'''Void Keeper''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Void Keeper's''' appearance and abilities are based on the [[Grave Digger]] enemy. **Internally, it is also called the ''Void Grave Digger'' and was referred to as the ''Voidgraver'' by BelowNatural when first announced.https://x.com/BelowNatural/status/2055747734204830141 **Its current name is likely a reference to the [[Gravekeeper]] enemy that existed before the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]]. **Despite all of these similarities, the '''Void Keeper''' is actually just a variant of the [[Slow King]] that decided they had to bury their kingdom. *The concept art of the '''Void Keeper''' was created by [https://www.roblox.com/users/445244958/profile @DaddyDonuts]. *The '''Void Keeper''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Void Keeper''' added, replacing the [[Grave Digger (Legacy)|Grave Digger]]. *'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]] **Health increased from 90,000 to 100,000 in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. **Health increased from 30,000 to 40,000 in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode. **''Summon'' changed: ***No longer summons the [[Void Rusher]], which used to have a 20% chance and a 0.3 delay. ***[[Voidling]] chance decreased from 10% to 6%. ***[[Voidling]] delay decreased from 0.6 to 0.55. ***[[Elite Lead]] chance increased from 30% to 32%. ***[[Elite Lead]] delay decreased from 0.15 to 0.125. ***[[Mandrake]] chance increased from 50% to 62%. ***[[Mandrake]] delay decreased from 0.15 to 0.125. **''Wayfarer'' changed: ***Speed decreased from 4 to 3.5 ***Health threshold decreased from 50% to 25%. ==Notes== {{Hardcore|[[Nightshade]]|Wave 35|Void Keeper|Wave 36|[[Soul]] & [[Slow King]]|Wave 37}} {{Voidcore|[[Void Brute]]|Wave 34|Void Keeper|Wave 35|[[Unknown Small]]|Wave 36}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]]
